overview: Complete mapping of the com.hypixel.hytale.protocol.packets (362 files, 270 actual packet types) and com.hypixel.hytale.protocol.io (9 files) packages. The protocol uses a code-generated binary wire format over QUIC (via Netty), with Zstd compression for large payloads, VarInt length-prefixed arrays, nullable bit fields, and fixed+variable block layouts. Packets are organized into 17 sub-packages by functional domain. Each packet implements Packet plus ToClientPacket and/or ToServerPacket marker interfaces. The PacketRegistry statically registers all 268 unique packet IDs (some packets implement Both directions on a single ID) across 3 NetworkChannels (Default, Chunks, WorldMap).

io_infrastructure.overview: The protocol.io package provides the binary serialization layer. PacketIO handles framing, compression, and primitive read/write. VarInt implements variable-length integer encoding. PacketDecoder/PacketEncoder are Netty channel handlers. ProtocolUtil manages QUIC connection lifecycle. PacketStatsRecorder tracks bandwidth statistics per packet type.

types.name: PacketIO
types.description: Central serialization utility. Handles framed packet read/write with Zstd compression, half-float (16-bit) encoding, UUID read/write, fixed and variable-length string encoding (UTF-8 and ASCII), and byte/short/float array I/O. All reads use absolute ByteBuf offsets (getByte, getIntLE); writes use sequential (writeByte, writeIntLE).
key_methods: writeFramedPacket(Packet, Class, ByteBuf, PacketStatsRecorder) — serializes a packet with 4-byte LE length prefix + 4-byte LE packet ID + optional Zstd compression
readFramedPacket(ByteBuf, int, PacketStatsRecorder) — reads packet ID, looks up PacketInfo, delegates to readFramedPacketWithInfo
readFramedPacketWithInfo(ByteBuf, int, PacketInfo, PacketStatsRecorder) — handles decompression if compressed, then calls info.deserialize()
readVarString / writeVarString — VarInt-length-prefixed UTF-8 strings with max-length enforcement

constants.COMPRESSION_LEVEL: System property hytale.protocol.compressionLevel, defaults to Zstd.defaultCompressionLevel()

wire_format.frame: [4 bytes LE payload length] [4 bytes LE packet ID] [payload bytes, optionally Zstd-compressed]

types.name: VarInt
types.description: Variable-length integer encoding (1-5 bytes, 7 bits per byte, MSB continuation bit). Used for array lengths, string lengths, and polymorphic type IDs throughout the protocol. Does not support negative values.
key_methods: peek(ByteBuf, int) — decode at absolute offset without advancing
length(ByteBuf, int) — return byte count of VarInt at offset
size(int) — compute encoded byte count without writing

types.name: ProtocolException
types.description: Protocol-level error with typed factory methods for common violations: arrayTooLong, stringTooLong, dictionaryTooLarge, bufferTooSmall, invalidVarInt, negativeLength, invalidOffset, unknownPolymorphicType, duplicateKey, invalidEnumValue, valueOutOfRange, and more.

types.name: ValidationResult
types.description: Result type for structural validation of incoming packets. ValidationResult.OK is the singleton success. Each packet class has a static validateStructure(ByteBuf, int) that returns this.

types.name: PacketStatsRecorder
types.description: Per-connection bandwidth statistics tracker. Records send/receive counts, uncompressed/compressed sizes, min/max/avg, and 30-second rolling stats per packet ID. Stored as a Netty channel attribute. Default implementation is NoopPacketStatsRecorder.

types.name: NoopPacketStatsRecorder
types.description: No-op implementation of PacketStatsRecorder. All methods return zero/empty. Used when stats recording is disabled.

types.name: PacketDecoder
types.description: Netty inbound handler that decodes framed packets from the byte stream. Reads 4-byte LE payload length + 4-byte LE packet ID, validates against PacketRegistry (ToServer direction), checks NetworkChannel match, decompresses if needed, and outputs deserialized Packet objects. Implements a custom packet timeout (configurable via PACKET_TIMEOUT_KEY channel attribute) that fires ReadTimeoutException when no packets arrive within the deadline. Closes connection on any protocol violation.

types.name: PacketEncoder
types.description: Netty outbound handler that encodes Packet objects into framed bytes. Handles CachedPacket unwrapping, NetworkChannel validation, and delegates to PacketIO.writeFramedPacket(). Marked @Sharable so a single instance can be shared across channels.

types.name: ProtocolUtil
types.description: QUIC connection lifecycle utilities. Provides closeConnection() (transport error) and closeApplicationConnection() (application error with reason string). Defines application-level error codes and Netty channel attribute keys for stream channel ID and packet timeout.
attribute_keys: STREAM_CHANNEL_KEY (NetworkChannel) — identifies which logical channel this QUIC stream belongs to
PACKET_TIMEOUT_KEY (Duration) — configurable timeout for idle connections

network_channels.overview: Three logical channels multiplex over the QUIC connection. Each packet is registered to exactly one channel. The decoder validates that incoming packets match the stream's assigned channel.

channels.name: Default
channels.description: Used by the vast majority of packets — auth, setup, player, entities, inventory, interface, camera, interaction, machinima, serveraccess, assets, asseteditor, buildertools, window

channels.name: Chunks
channels.description: Dedicated channel for world chunk data: SetChunk, SetChunkHeightmap, SetChunkTintmap, SetChunkEnvironments, SetFluids, UnloadChunk, ServerSetBlock, ServerSetBlocks, ServerSetFluid, ServerSetFluids, UpdateBlockDamage (11 packet types)

channels.name: WorldMap
channels.description: Dedicated channel for world map: ClearWorldMap, UpdateWorldMap (2 packet types)

packet_registration.overview: PacketRegistry is a static registry mapping integer IDs to PacketInfo records. Registration happens in a static initializer block. Each registration specifies direction (ToServer/ToClient/Both), NetworkChannel, numeric ID, name, Java class, fixedBlockSize, maxSize, compressed flag, validate function, and deserialize function. The registry maintains three maps: BY_ID (all), TO_SERVER_BY_ID, TO_CLIENT_BY_ID, plus BY_TYPE for class-to-ID lookup.

packet_structure_pattern.overview: All packet classes are code-generated and follow a uniform structure. They have static constants (PACKET_ID, IS_COMPRESSED, NULLABLE_BIT_FIELD_SIZE, FIXED_BLOCK_SIZE, VARIABLE_FIELD_COUNT, VARIABLE_BLOCK_START, MAX_SIZE), public fields for payload data, and standard methods (deserialize, serialize, computeSize, computeBytesConsumed, validateStructure, clone, equals, hashCode). The binary layout is: [nullable bit field bytes] [fixed-size fields in LE byte order] [variable field offset table as LE int32s] [variable-length data (strings, arrays, nested structs)].

cross_references.overview: Maps which server systems send/receive which packet categories.

systems_to_packets.notes: Handles QUIC connection lifecycle, keep-alive, and graceful disconnection.
Implements token-based auth with optional password challenge-response and server transfer via referral.
Orchestrates world loading sequence: settings -> asset transfer -> progress -> finished -> ready.
All use the Chunks NetworkChannel. Handles chunk streaming and incremental block/fluid updates.
EntityUpdates is the primary bandwidth consumer — compressed, carries all entity state changes per tick including ComponentUpdate array.
Core player loop: client sends movement/input per tick, server sends teleports/damage/mode changes.
UpdatePlayerInventory sends full inventory state (7 sections). Individual operations use dedicated packets.
Polymorphic WindowAction supports crafting, slot selection, sorting, tier upgrade, category filtering.
Syncs interaction chain state bidirectionally. Chains reference interactions defined in UpdateInteractions.
Supports server-driven custom UI via DOM-like command system (Append, Remove, SetText, etc.) with event bindings.
Tab list management with batched ping updates.
Map chunk images use dedicated WorldMap NetworkChannel. Supports user-created markers and coordinate teleportation.
Full day/night cycle with moon phases, weather transitions, and sleep-to-skip-night multiplayer voting.
All server-to-client. Sound events and particle spawning use integer indices into registry data.

packets: All 45 UpdateXxx packets in assets package
systems_to_packets.notes: 45 ToClient packets that sync the full game data registry (blocks, items, interactions, sounds, particles, effects, fluids, recipes, environments, etc.). Most are compressed. Each supports Init (full) and Update (incremental) modes.
Full in-game asset editing system with file browsing, JSON editing, undo/redo, export/import, model preview, and collaborative edit notifications.
Creative-mode world editing: brush painting, selection, clipboard, extrude, stack, entity manipulation.
In-game filmmaking system for animating scenes.
Server privacy mode management.
Server-controlled camera perspective locking and fly camera mode.

statistics.compressed_packets: ~50 (mostly assets, chunks, editor, inventory, window, world map)
